text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A showdown against Special Week, Grass 
Wonder, and T.M. Opera O. Facing such 
formidable opponents, Meisho Doto begins 
to lose her confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, that very "lack of confidence" 
was her own unique weapon. Bearing the 
weight of her relentless, unceasing 
efforts, she stepped out onto the turf!
